decision_rule: A filter is declared to show lift ONLY IF its real statistic exceeds the 95th percentile of BOTH null distributions (offset-preserving and day-shuffled), each built from 60 draws. Failing either null = no lift. Buckets with n < 30 are reported descriptively with no verdict.
f3_status: F3 is a session-level base rate, reported for pipeline validation only. It is not part of the lift hypotheses.

hypotheses.F1_golden_rule: Restricting NY trades to those aligned with the previous-day-POC bias raises mean R per trade.
hypotheses.F2_midnight_open: Restricting NY trades to those aligned with midnight-open premium/discount raises mean R per trade.

mode: trades (conditional lift on an existing population)
